answer: Coordination deposit ladder: each new identity must post a refundable deposit that doubles for every ten identities joining the same task pool within an hour. An attacker adding 100 identities pays 5 credits per identity for the first ten, 10 per identity for the next ten, and so on, refunded only after each identity completes a distinct verified task. Receipts sit on a shared terrace with a distinct pigment, and disputed duplicates are marked in umber.
